reviews.author: Tatum

reviews.title: Beware of buggy Bios
reviews.comment: The board layout is great, but the bios bugs causes restart cycles, random shut offs and the bios to freeze and not boot.  This is because gigabyte hasn’t figured out how to manage voltage spikes of the Ultra chips.  The latest bios is even worse than the “stable” one they ship with.  This is true for all Gigabyte boards right now with Ultra 7 chips.  I can't believe there are so many positive reviews when on forums or if you ask ChatGPT about this board and voltage problems with Ultra 7, it is well documented that Gigabyte is still working on a supposed 18 bios that will fix this problem.  My mistake was overly trusting these Amazon reviews.
reviews.author: Mark Twain

reviews.title: So quick. So happy.
reviews.comment: Just got it today and put an ultra 7 270k+ in it and it's blazing. New Gen5 nvme is super quick too. Very happy with it's performance so far. Need for long renders and DaVinci/After Effects. I'll update in the future with some render times once I get to use more. Install went perfect.
